Class AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler

public without sharing class AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler
extends TriggerHandler

Trigger handler for the AccountContactRelation object. Routes trigger context events to AccountContactRelationTriggerHelper methods for email notification duplicate validation, main contact designation, and BlazeBite agent count updates. Each method is configurable via TriggerHandlerSettings__c.
